themes.flavorText: 潮光从柔软的深渊皮膜中缓慢呼吸。
孢子与湿润苔色长成一团好奇的生命。
温柔的暗色轮廓把微光悄悄藏在身后。

parts.flavorText: 一团稳稳坐住的柔软圆影。
parts.description: a complete squat rounded blob body silhouette, featureless and limb-free, with a softly flattened bottom

parts.flavorText: 像一小片落到地面的蓬松云。
parts.description: a complete extra-wide low cloud-blob body silhouette with two gentle asymmetric lobes, featureless and limb-free

parts.flavorText: 圆肚皮下面藏着两只短短的脚墩。
parts.description: a complete upright peanut-shaped biped torso with two very short rounded leg-stump foundations and no feet details

parts.flavorText: 它努力站高一点，又不舍得失去圆润。
parts.description: a complete slightly taller rounded biped body silhouette with a small waist and two soft leg-stump foundations

parts.flavorText: 一滴没有落下的软光停在半空。
parts.description: a complete hovering teardrop-cloud body silhouette with a rounded crown and gently tapered lower edge, no ground contact

parts.flavorText: 一个适合装下许多好奇心的圆脑袋。
parts.description: a separate rounded dome-shaped plush monster head shell with a flat hidden attachment underside and no face

parts.flavorText: 软软的伞沿会在高兴时轻轻抖动。
parts.description: a separate friendly mushroom-cap head shell with a thick rounded brim, velvety texture, and no face

parts.flavorText: 一根短短的柔软灯茎，从暗紫兜帽上举起暖光。
parts.description: a compact low deep-violet hood head shell with a flat hidden underside, composited with one short flexible dark-plum lure stalk ending in one warm orange bulb; no face or torso

parts.flavorText: 暗色软帽里只藏着一点温柔。
parts.description: a separate rounded hood-like plush head shell with a softly folded crown, friendly not sinister, no face

parts.flavorText: 两颗亮眼总比嘴巴更早发现新朋友。

parts.flavorText: 一只看现在，一只急着看下一秒。
parts.description: a friendly asymmetric pair of glossy cartoon eyes, one large and one small, with coordinated curious pupils

parts.flavorText: 第三只眼只负责欣赏漂亮的光。
parts.description: three rounded pearl-like glossy cartoon eyes arranged in a gentle shallow arc, cute rather than eerie

parts.flavorText: 它看起来快睡着了，其实什么都知道。
parts.description: a pair of soft crescent-shaped sleepy eyelids with tiny glossy pupils, calm and friendly

parts.flavorText: 两颗眼睛踮起脚尖向外张望。
parts.description: a pair of short rounded eye stalks ending in oversized glossy friendly eyeballs, compact and toy-like

parts.flavorText: 它的笑容总是比脑袋先挤进画面。
parts.description: a separate oversized wide smiling cartoon mouth opening with thick soft rounded lips and a dark warm interior, no teeth

parts.flavorText: 并没有生气，只是在认真吹一颗看不见的泡泡。
parts.description: a separate small plush puckered pout mouth with rounded lips, playful and friendly, no teeth

parts.flavorText: 像小鸟一样啾一声，却软得像橡皮糖。
parts.description: a separate short rounded soft-cartoon beak mouth made of flexible toy-like material, no sharp point

parts.flavorText: 每一件小事都值得发出一声圆圆的惊叹。
parts.description: a separate vertical oval surprised mouth opening with a thick rounded rim and warm dark interior, friendly not frightened

parts.flavorText: 牙齿参差不齐，但每一颗都很钝。
parts.description: a separate curved row of six irregular blunt rounded cream cartoon teeth, gummy and harmless

parts.flavorText: 唯一的一颗小牙非常努力地露在外面。

parts.flavorText: 它一专心，舌头就会偷偷跑出来。

parts.flavorText: 像牙又像软糖，咬什么都只会弹一下。
parts.description: a separate row of rounded translucent gummy mouth ridges, tooth-like but soft and friendly

parts.flavorText: 光秃秃也很神气。
parts.description: no visible head appendage at all

parts.flavorText: 两颗角还没决定要往哪边长。
parts.description: a symmetric pair of very short rounded plush horn nubs, flexible and harmless, no sharp tips

parts.flavorText: 想到好点子时，两颗小灯会一起亮。

parts.flavorText: 抱不住大东西，却很会挥手。

parts.description: a separate bilateral pair of short sturdy plush legs ending in broad rounded pad feet

parts.flavorText: 水洼再小，也值得认真划两下。
parts.description: a separate bilateral pair of short rounded legs with soft three-lobed webbed feet, no claws

parts.flavorText: 走累了就把自己当成两朵小蘑菇。
parts.description: a separate bilateral pair of stout mushroom-stem legs with small rounded cap-like feet

parts.flavorText: 脚尖其实很圆，只是影子把它拉长了。
parts.description: a separate bilateral pair of tapered shadow-plush legs ending in tiny rounded tiptoe pads, soft not sharp

parts.flavorText: 身后空空的，转身更轻松。
parts.description: no visible tail at all

parts.flavorText: 轻轻一摆，就把想象里的海水推开。
parts.description: a separate side-view rounded fan-shaped fish tail with soft translucent ribbing and a compact attachment base

parts.flavorText: 尾巴末端总在画一个没有画完的圆。
parts.description: a separate thick curled plush tail shaped like a loose spiral, with a rounded attachment base and tip

parts.flavorText: 尾巴上挤着三朵总想一起点头的小菌伞。
parts.description: a separate short plush tail ending in a cluster of three tiny rounded mushroom caps, compact and friendly

parts.flavorText: 两侧留白，刚好装下风。
parts.description: no visible extra appendage at all

parts.flavorText: 翅膀像两片会呼吸的软绒叶。

parts.flavorText: 几根软带在身后慢半拍地挥手。
parts.description: a separate bilateral arrangement of four short ribbon-like soft tentacle appendages with rounded tips, cute and non-anatomical

parts.flavorText: 它不一定会游泳，但鳍很乐意试试。

parts.flavorText: 摸起来像一阵刚晒过太阳的软风。
parts.description: a sparse modular overlay of fine short plush fibers and soft highlight tufts following the masked body surface; only fibers visible, no opaque body fill

parts.flavorText: 半透明小泡在皮肤下面慢慢挪位置。
parts.description: a modular overlay of rounded translucent gel bubbles, glossy soft highlights, and sparse droplets following the body mask; no opaque body fill

parts.flavorText: 每片鳞都像圆圆的小指纹。
parts.description: a modular overlay of broad overlapping rounded soft scales with subtle highlights, sparse enough to reveal the base; no opaque body fill

parts.flavorText: 细密菌绒让它总像刚从苔床上醒来。
parts.description: a modular overlay of velvety micro-spore fuzz and a few soft raised patches following the body mask; no opaque body fill

parts.flavorText: 大小不一的圆斑像在皮肤上玩捉迷藏。
parts.description: a modular overlay of twelve irregular rounded coral and cream spots distributed within the body mask; spots only, no body fill

parts.flavorText: 几道弧线顺着圆肚皮慢慢弯过去。
parts.description: a modular overlay of five broad softly curved lavender-blue stripes following the body volume; stripes only, no body fill

parts.flavorText: 身上的小光点总想连成一幅新星图。
parts.description: a modular overlay of tiny warm-gold star dots connected by a few faint curved lines within the body mask; marks only

parts.flavorText: 一圈圈菌纹记录了它做过的软绵绵的梦。
parts.description: a modular overlay of soft amber concentric spore rings and dotted arcs within the body mask; marks only, no body fill

parts.flavorText: 深蓝里藏着一小口温暖的珊瑚光。
parts.description: a modular palette overlay of deep ocean-blue primary patches, aqua secondary patches, and warm-gold accents arranged in three broad body-following zones; color patches only

parts.flavorText: 泥土色、奶油色和琥珀橙在一起发芽。
parts.description: a modular palette overlay of olive primary patches, lime secondary patches, and warm-orange accents arranged in three broad body-following zones; color patches only

parts.flavorText: 紫色把影子抱紧，金光从缝里探头。
parts.description: a modular palette overlay of deep violet primary patches, dusty lilac secondary patches, and warm gold accents arranged in three broad body-following zones; color patches only

parts.flavorText: 安安静静地站着，本身就足够奇妙。
parts.description: no visible effect at all

parts.flavorText: 几颗小光泡像朋友一样围着它慢慢游。
parts.description: a modular foreground effect layer of seven small warm bioluminescent floating orbs with very soft halos, sparse and isolated

parts.flavorText: 轻轻一抖，身边就亮起一阵会打哈欠的孢子。
parts.description: a modular foreground effect layer of sparse amber glowing spores drifting upward in a gentle arc, isolated particles only

想到好点子时，两颗小灯会一起亮。

抱不住大东西，却很会挥手。
手臂晃起来像两根开心的软面条。

水洼再小，也值得认真划两下。

几根软带在身后慢半拍地挥手。
它不一定会游泳，但鳍很乐意试试。
摸起来像一阵刚晒过太阳的软风。
半透明小泡在皮肤下面慢慢挪位置。
每片鳞都像圆圆的小指纹。
细密菌绒让它总像刚从苔床上醒来。
大小不一的圆斑像在皮肤上玩捉迷藏。
几道弧线顺着圆肚皮慢慢弯过去。
身上的小光点总想连成一幅新星图。
一圈圈菌纹记录了它做过的软绵绵的梦。
深蓝里藏着一小口温暖的珊瑚光。
泥土色、奶油色和琥珀橙在一起发芽。
紫色把影子抱紧，金光从缝里探头。
遇到陌生声响时，它先递出一只软绒绒的手。
每一扇门缝后面，都可能藏着值得认识的新朋友。
腿会抖，但仍会往前挪半步。
它常常盯着空气里不存在的泡泡发呆。
藏好尾巴之前，它已经把恶作剧笑出了声。
被看见时，它会把自己的微光调暗一点。
只要有一点亮，它就忍不住跟着走。
一紧张，就会打出一串暖呼呼的小孢子。
安静时，肚子里会传出很小的海浪声。
它把喜欢的声音叠好，藏在柔软肚皮里。
本体停下以后，影子还会多走一小步。
睡着以后，未做完的梦会变成小泡泡飘出去。

modifiers.flavorText: 色素退成月光般的奶白，暖色仍藏在耳尖与软边里。
第二颗脑袋从旁边探出，和第一颗共享同一份好奇。
本不该相遇的颜色挤到一起，却意外唱得很响亮。
有一组眼睛走错了位置，仍然认真地看着同一个方向。
